headline: Enhance Local Crypto Tracker with Real-Time Data and User Interaction
summary: To improve the Local Crypto Tracker, integrate real-time cryptocurrency price updates from reliable APIs and add interactive features like user-defined watchlists and notifications for price changes. This will provide users with more accurate and timely information, enhancing their overall experience.
actions: Integrate a real-time cryptocurrency API to fetch up-to-date prices
Allow users to create custom watchlists of cryptocurrencies they are interested in tracking
Implement push notifications for significant price movements in the user's selected cryptocurrencies
